$comment: input.inputFingerprint stands for the trusted caller's identity of the original SARIF artifact plus options; it is independent of the prepared request. A wholly validated prepared contribution as the core would hand it to the publication coordinator, plus the create-review request the coordinator must send for it. expectedRequest is authored separately from input (not derived from it) so a coordinator that drops, reorders fields of, rewrites, or re-targets a comment is detected. expectedRequest.bodyBeforeMarker is the body the request must carry before the coordinator's single appended marker; the marker itself is random per publication identity and is checked structurally.
